mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, signaled by a 3% m-o-m decline in INDPRO, indicates a supply shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as companies struggle with input disruptions.
failure_condition: INDPRO declines by > 3% m-o-m but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the unemployment rate, defined as the UNRATE rising by > 0.5pp over 3 months, signals a weakening labor market and slowing consumer demand that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises by > 0.5pp over 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the housing starts series HOUST crosses above its 12-month moving average, it signals an improving housing market that will boost consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST crosses above its 12-month MA but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate FEDFUNDS is below 1% and falling, it indicates an aggressive monetary easing cycle that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as financial conditions loosen.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS is below 1% and falling but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 35% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real retail sales RSAFS are rising faster than CPI inflation CPIAUCSL over a 6-month period, it signals strong consumer demand that will boost corporate revenues and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS 6-month growth exceeds CPIAUCSL growth but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 45% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment PAYEMS is rising by > 200k jobs per month for 3 consecutive months, it signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation and negatively impact corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 200k per month for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: PAYEMS rises by > 200k per month for 3 consecutive months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index INDPRO is falling while the unemployment rate UNRATE is simultaneously rising, it signals a stagflationary environment that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as companies face input constraints and slowing demand.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falling and UNRATE rising simultaneously
failure_condition: INDPRO is falling while UNRATE is rising simultaneously, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.
